name: Goblin Mage
problem: My fireball spell now creates soup.
success: The fireball works again. Unfortunately the soup is now explosive.
failure: The goblin becomes legally classified as chowder.

name: Skeleton Archer
problem: My left arm disconnected during battle.
solutions: Turn skeleton off and on again
success: The skeleton now has TOO MANY arms.
failure: The skeleton files a workplace complaint.

name: Dragon Accountant
problem: My treasure hoard won't calculate taxes.
success: The kingdom no longer has a tax department.

name: Orc Blacksmith
problem: My anvil is making a weird noise.
solutions: Convince the orc to switch to a different profession
success: The anvil is quiet again, but now it's also very slippery.
failure: The orc's anvil is now classified as a musical instrument.

name: Annoyed Elf
problem: Coworker had turned on Subway surfer on second monitor while working
success: The elf can now focus on work, but is also very confused about why the second monitor is off.
failure: The elf's productivity drops by 50% due to constant distraction.

name: Confused Boss
problem: Jeff Stole all the paper towels and used them to make a sculpture of himself and put it on my desk
solutions: Politely ask Jeff to remove the sculpture
Report Jeff to HR for inappropriate desk decorations
Join Jeff in his paper towel art project
success: Jeff apologizes and removes the sculpture, restoring order to the office.
failure: The boss becomes obsessed with the sculpture and starts a new office trend of paper towel art, leading to a shortage of paper towels for actual use.

name: Addicted Goul
solutions: Convince goul to switch to a different addiction
success: The goul successfully completes moss rehab and is now addicted to grass instead.
failure: The goul's addiction worsens and it starts hoarding moss, leading to a moss infestation in the office.
